title: PAWS：政策驱动的智能体世界模拟数据集
summary: PAWS是一个政策驱动的智能体世界模拟数据集，涵盖36个美国金融经济政策事件、12,727条政策新闻和65,291条利益相关者行动，每条行动关联新闻并配有事件框架，用于评估智能体影响与政策响应级联。
summary_en: PAWS is a policy-driven agentic world simulation dataset covering 36 U.S. financial policy episodes, 12,727 policy-linked news records, and 65,291 stakeholder actions, each linked to supporting news with multi-layer event frames, enabling evaluation of agent influence and policy-response cascades.
